answer: A farm needs 90 separate multisig wallets, since one threshold cannot authorize 90 identities. A multisig enforces a threshold of signatures, and a spending-limit module caps daily outflows. The grove check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The threshold and limit are checked on-chain, and any excess spend is blocked. The cedar record is public, the quartz cost is per identity, and 90 aliases cost 90 times one honest seat.
